question: Which state has become the first state to launch a dedicated Semiconductor Policy in July 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Gujarat has been actively promoting its electronics and hardware manufacturing industry for the past few years, and this move is a part of that effort.**
 
• The Semiconductor Policy aims to **attract investments** in semiconductor manufacturing, research and development, and related infrastructure in the state.
 
• The policy includes **various incentives for semiconductor companies**, such as subsidies on land, power, and water, and exemption from certain taxes and duties.
 
• The policy also aims to create a** skilled workforce for the semiconductor industry** by setting up training programs and collaborating with educational institutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Haryana:** Haryana has been promoting its electronics industry through its Electronics System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) Policy, but it has not launched a dedicated Semiconductor Policy.
 
• **Madhya Pradesh: **Madhya Pradesh has been promoting its electronics industry through its Electronics Manufacturing Policy, but it has not launched a dedicated Semiconductor Policy.
 
• ** Kerala:** Kerala has been promoting its electronics industry through its Electronics and Hardware Manufacturing Policy, but it has not launched a dedicated Semiconductor Policy. However, Kerala has been in the news for its efforts to promote open source hardware and software, which could complement the semiconductor industry.
